description: This file defines a React functional component called PrivateRoute that wraps around React Router's Route component to enforce authentication-based access control. It uses Redux's useSelector to access authentication state and conditionally renders the component or redirects to the home page.

classes.name: PrivateRoute
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a route only if the user is authenticated; otherwise, it redirects to the home page.

methods.name: PrivateRoute
methods.description: React functional component implementing a private route based on authentication status.
